title: Torus Lab Manifest
description: Binds a lab's visual/textual claims to fully-qualified verified theorem names. Every visible claim in a lab MUST appear here with the theorem that backs it; a claim with no theorem (or a theorem absent from the verified registry) renders as BLOCKED (⊘ UNVERIFIED) by the VerifiedClaim component. A picture cannot show a claim the registry does not back.

description.description: Short description of what the lab visualizes.

registrySchema.description: Expected public-registry schema version this manifest was authored against.

claims.description: The claim-to-theorem bindings for this lab.

claim.description: The human-facing assertion the visual makes (e.g. 'exactly 5 admissible residues mod 5').

theorem.description: Fully-qualified theorem name used as the verified-registry key (e.g. 'Brockian.Admissibility.admissibility_count_five'). MUST resolve in the public registry or the claim renders BLOCKED.

visualRef.description: Optional reference to the visual element the claim annotates (DOM id, figure key, frame index, etc.).
